guide.title: About TerminalNexus
guide.subtitle:
A terminal-themed playground for developers.
Community and mini games, all in one place.

items.name: Free Board
items.desc: Post text, images and videos, and discuss with comments and replies. Like or dislike posts.

items.name: Live Chat
items.desc: Public chat, an anonymous room, and whispers with /w nickname.

items.name: Stock Simulator
items.desc: Trade virtual stocks with live-moving prices using virtual money. Order book, charts and a profit ranking.

items.name: Janggi
items.desc: Play Korean chess against the AI, with a friend on one screen, or online in real time.

items.name: Forge
items.desc: Upgrade your weapon to the highest level — it might break. Records go to the hall of fame.

items.name: TypeRacer
items.desc: Type Linux and Git commands fast and accurately. Top 10 leaderboard.

items.name: Hacker Mode
items.desc: Mash any key and code pours out like a movie hacker's terminal.

items.name: Terminal Hack
items.desc: Find the password among candidates hidden in a memory dump, using letter-match hints.

items.name: Fruit AI
items.desc: Ask about the benefits of fruits and Gemini AI answers.

items.name: Weather · Lucky Draw
items.desc: See local weather and draw lottery numbers on the home page.

steps.title: Look around
steps.desc: Stocks, Janggi, TypeRacer and more work without logging in.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.desc: Create an ID, or start right away with Google or Naver.

steps.title: Keep records
steps.desc: Logged-in users can post and chat, and game records go to the rankings.

faqs.a: Everything is free. The site is supported by ads and voluntary donations.

faqs.q: Is the stock simulator real money?
faqs.a: No. You trade only with virtual money given on sign-up. It has nothing to do with real money or real stocks.
Passwords are stored with one-way BCrypt hashing, and social login only receives your name and email. See the privacy policy for details.

faqs.q: How do I delete my account?
faqs.a: You can delete your account any time from My Page.
